_comment: Source of truth for hal0 runner images. TWO orthogonal axes: (1) `ownership` = does the Dockerfile live in THIS repo (owned) or in an upstream repo we only pin (referenced); (2) `publish` = who builds+pushes the canonical image. publish values: 'ci' = THIS repo's build-matrix.yml builds+pushes it (only comfyui today; future new owned images e.g. vibevoice); 'external' = Dockerfile is archived here for provenance/reproducibility, but the canonical published image comes from another lineage — CI must NOT rebuild/repush it (would 403 on the pre-existing org package and/or overwrite the canonical artifact), we only pin its digest; 'manual' = referenced source repo builds it, pin only. The plan job builds ONLY publish=='ci'. scripts/emit-manifest.sh resolves the published ghcr digest for EVERY image with a manifest_key and PRs it into Hal0ai/hal0 manifest.json — independent of publish. rocmfpx/vulkanfpx use an app-side pin (DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE, schema.py) rather than manifest.json.toolbox_images. SCHEMA NOTE: `images` is an ARRAY (hal0's runner-image sync — src/hal0/registry/runner_image_sync.py — requires a list); each entry carries its short name in `id`. RUNTIME METADATA (Hal0ai/hal0 feat/catalogue-runtime-metadata): `runtime_family` = the runtime the image's entrypoint serves, same vocabulary as hal0's RuntimeFamily (src/hal0/runners/__init__.py); `supported_backends` = backends the runner binary can execute, same semantics as Runner.supported_backends (metadata, not a selector). hal0's sync merges both onto catalogue rows so the slot drawer's catalogued-pin lane stops assuming every row is llama-server.

images.notes: llama.cpp CPU/Vulkan fallback. Self-contained (clones llama.cpp in builder). Migrated as-is from app repo; BUILD-VERIFIED 2026-07-19 (builds clean on 143).

FastFlowLM v0.9.44 on AMD XDNA2 NPU. FLM_REF build-arg controls upstream tag. Migrated as-is from app repo; BUILD-VERIFIED 2026-07-19 (full XRT+Rust+FastFlowLM build completes clean on 143; runtime needs the NPU).

Kokoro-82M TTS (CPU ONNX). Dockerfile RECONSTRUCTED from image history 2026-07-19; rebuild-VERIFIED same day (built clean + container serves, /health 200 model_loaded=true, 54 voices, default af_bella).

Moonshine STT (CPU/Vulkan). Dockerfile RECONSTRUCTED from ghcr config blob 2026-07-19; rebuild-VERIFIED same day (built clean + container serves, /health 200 model_loaded=true, model_id moonshine-small_streaming-en).
Qwen3-TTS multilingual GPU TTS (ROCm). Migrated as-is from app repo packaging/toolbox. BUILD-VERIFIED 2026-07-19 (builds clean on 143; runtime needs GPU+model).

NEW hal0-owned ComfyUI (gfx1151 ROCm). Replaces third-party docker.io/kyuz0/amd-strix-halo-comfyui. Single ROCm image — no vulkan variant (see comfyui/README.md). All build inputs pinned 2026-07-19: fedora base by digest, torch triple by dated nightly (cp313 @ 20260501), ComfyUI + 3 nodes by commit SHA. SMOKE-TESTED on gfx1151 (143): builds, ROCm torch sees Radeon 8060S; ComfyUI 0.28.0 detects Total VRAM 118784 MB (~116 GiB GTT, native, NORMAL_VRAM) + gfx1151 + ROCm 7.13. Remaining before publish: push :latest + digest-pin in app manifest.
llama.cpp Vulkan backend (default Strix Halo iGPU). Built + published by amd-strix-halo-toolboxes' own CI (.github/workflows/build_and_publish.yml). NOT vendored here — pin only.
llama.cpp ROCm backend, multi-arch gfx1030..gfx1151. Built by amd-strix-halo-toolboxes CI. NOT vendored here.

Canonical ROCmFPX+Vulkan combined runner (llama-server). Built from Hal0ai/hal0 packaging/runner/rocmfpx/build.sh; tag pinned app-side (DEFAULT_ROCMFPX_IMAGE). No pinned tag here on purpose: the hal0 catalogue tracks tags/list so fresh pushes surface on sync.

Pristine-upstream llama.cpp variant of the combined runner (adds qwen4exp / Qwen3.8-Flash-Next; lacks ROCmFPX quant formats and the MiniCPM5/LFM2.5 patches). Built from Hal0ai/hal0 packaging/runner/upstream/build.sh; wire to slots ONLY via per-slot image_pin, never as the default. Temporary: retire per Hal0ai/hal0#2118 once ROCmFPX syncs qwen4exp.

Hy3 variant of the FPX runner: adds IFP2 (ggml type107) + minicpm5 + the hy_v3 NextN/MTP patch so Hy3-Chadrock-FPX-IFP2-MTP loads. Built 2026-07-14 on CT105; was local-only until pushed to ghcr 2026-07-19. Both floating tag :ifp2-hyv3-mtp and digest-named :ifp2-hyv3-d7e1f26 share manifest sha256:dbb443fc… (config/image id 57aaafb773b1). Builder toolchain localhost/hal0-rocmfpx-builder:7.2.4 (may or may not be pushed). Referenced, digest-pinned; app follow-up: repin [profile.hy3-fpx] from :ifp2-hyv3-mtp to the digest. hy3 slot enabled=false (91GB weights can't co-reside with agent slot on 128GB).

images.notes: Accelerated HIP-only runner (GGML_VULKAN=OFF) for jcbtc/Qwen3.8-27B-CIRU-ActiveFPX-PromptForge — mutually exclusive with hal0-combined, never the general default. ciru-ai tree (ciru's gfx1151 Vulkan defect never executes in a HIP-only build) + the card's 627-line Output-K8 runtime patch. Built on CT130 via the tracked app-repo recipe (Gitea lane: build-promptforge.yml in the -dev sidecar); manifest_key stays null until the #1891 gate passes, then manifest.json.toolbox_images.promptforge is re-added with the real digest (it was deliberately removed — release-check fails on null digest).
